purpose: APP4 business policy values, versioned through policy_configurations / policy_configuration_versions (TBL-076 / TBL-077). Data only: the publishing caller is APP4-B01, and no seed runner is introduced here.
idempotency: Upsert by the natural key policy_configurations.config_key (ensureKey), then append one version (publishVersion). Re-running publishes a further identical version rather than mutating an immutable one.

configurations.description: Contact verification challenge issuance, expiry, attempt and rate policy (APP4-G01).
Secure access grant validity and step-up re-verification window (APP4-G01).
Automatic notification transport attempt budget and backoff schedule, consumed by the APP2 outbox worker runtime (APP4-G01).
Transport-abuse limit on the public secure-link resolve route. Counts requests only and never outcomes, so it cannot become a token-validity oracle (APP4-G01).
